narration.full_text: Namaste students! Today, we're diving into the fascinating world of how our bodies react to stimuli without us even thinking about it. We'll explore reflex actions and the incredible pathway they follow, known as the reflex arc. By the end of this session, you'll be able to define what a reflex action is and understand its crucial importance in our daily lives. We will also trace the complete pathway a nerve impulse takes during a reflex, from the moment a stimulus is detected to the final response. Furthermore, you'll be able to identify and describe each of the key components that make up this reflex arc, giving you a comprehensive understanding of this rapid response system. Let's begin our exploration!
